reviews.t: The Best Micellar Water I've EVER Tried!
reviews.x: I have sensitive, acne prone skin. I've used 5 other brands of micellar water: 2 major chemical-laden brands and 3 natural.  All of them irritated my skin and/or caused breakouts... even the natural ones. inVitamin is the only one that feels NOTHING but clean on my face! The list of ingredients is short, which is really hard to find. I just purchased my 4th bottle and will never buy anything else! Try it!!

I'm on my second bottle of this. For me, it does a good job removing make-up. I wear eye shadow, mascara, blush, and sometimes eye liner - for the mascara I sometimes have to use a second cotton pad. But it's so much more convenient than all the splashing and hair-wetting involved in cleansing with soap/water. The inVitamin product also has light floral smell that I really like, and it is very lightly oily, so I find I don't actually need to also use a moisturizer at night. When I first switched

I expected this to cleanse at least somewhat, and was suprised at how well this really did. I'm 36 and I have an oily T zone. This micellar water is amazing!!! A friend talked me into getting some but I had my doubts about effectiveness. With the exception of mascara, this product removes all the dirt ane makeup off ny face leaving it feeling clean and soft. It can feel a tad bit sticky as it's drying but that doesn't last long. In addition, I have extremely sensitive and reactionary skin that breaks out easily and this micellar water did not cause any irritation. I'm very happy and will purchase again.

Your skin will thank you and look so clean, smooth, soft, and inexplicably moisturized! Seems too good to be true.

reviews.t: Finally a natural cleansing water that works great!
reviews.x: I'm a huge fan of cleansing waters, it just makes things so much easier when in a rush and it's great for morning routines when you're not wearing make-up and don't need a heavy duty cleanser. I love that this is natural and has great ingredients, that's what makes this one stand apart from the others I've used. It works well too, leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed but not dry.

It is a great toner! The best one I've ever had actually. Smells great and really takes away grime like nothing I've ever seen. The first 3 I received were clear like water, but the last 4 have stuff floating in them. Im pretty sure its the cap that was suppose to seal it. It leaves the toner cloudy-looking and feel rough against my skin. Rating 3 stars because of that.

I have been using this for about a month and I love it. I have incredibly sensitive skin and products made for such tend to make my skin breakout or give me a rash. This is simple and cleans well. I use it twice a day to remove dirt buildup. On the days I wear makeup, it works well for removing. I will continue to buy.
I love this product. It is cruelty free and gets the job done. I love the smell too! It smells like roses.
If you do not like the smell of rose water, do not buy this product. I wish I had known about the scent.

claims.text: Reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin report it is gentle and does not cause breakouts or irritation.
It effectively removes makeup and cleanses, though some note mascara may need a second cotton pad.
Many reviewers are repeat buyers who praise it as the best micellar water they've tried.
Reviewers like the light rose scent and natural, simple ingredient list.
One reviewer reported floating white flakes and cloudy product in recent bottles.
